kpis.title: Gate arrival handling time
kpis.source: AccessRequest lifecycle audit plus pilot observation record
kpis.measurement: Measure request creation to final approved/denied decision for delivery/cab/visitor arrivals during representative peak periods; report p50 and p95 separately.
kpis.threshold: p95 <= 45 seconds for routine arrivals; no authorization bypass

kpis.title: Voice quick-fill safe completion
kpis.source: Guard voice quick-fill plus AccessRequest draft/submit audit
kpis.measurement: Run representative eight-language short-command cases and record successful draft fill, manual fallback, ambiguity handling and review-before-submit.
kpis.threshold: 100% ambiguous destinations require manual selection; 0 voice-triggered auto approvals

kpis.title: Bank reconciliation review quality
kpis.measurement: Measure matched, unmatched and stale unmatched transactions after accountant review of a representative bank statement period.
kpis.threshold: No duplicate journal match; stale unmatched items have explicit review disposition before period close

kpis.title: Accounting export reconciliation
kpis.source: Accounting export artifact hash plus downstream reconciliation worksheet
kpis.measurement: Reconcile exported journal totals and row counts against the same pilot accounting period.
kpis.threshold: 100% period total agreement or documented accepted exception

kpis.title: Permission-scoped operational cards
kpis.measurement: Validate finance/helpdesk/security/facility cards for representative roles and negative roles.
kpis.threshold: 0 unauthorized domain cards; 0 direct mutation from Action Centre

kpis.title: Helpdesk SLA attention
kpis.source: HelpdeskTicket SLA state and Action Centre helpdesk card
kpis.measurement: Track open, breached and unassigned tickets during the pilot and review escalation handling.
kpis.threshold: Every breached ticket has an owner/escalation disposition within the society's configured operating policy

kpis.title: Resident next-action usefulness
kpis.source: Resident property-scoped Home highlights and Updates timeline
kpis.measurement: Run resident tasks for maintenance, notice acknowledgement and active service booking across multiple-property test users.
kpis.threshold: 0 cross-property items; users can reach the relevant task from the surfaced highlight without dead-end navigation

kpis.title: Support and escalation readiness
kpis.source: V4.11 pilot playbook incident log and training attendance records
kpis.measurement: Exercise one scripted support escalation and one rollback/incident communication tabletop before pilot start.
kpis.threshold: Named owner, severity, response path and evidence recorded for every scripted exercise
